comparison.objective: Clip a spring-hinged pulse oximeter fully onto a manikin index finger without dragging the hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hand stabilization, spring-jaw opening, finger alignment, and controlled placement.
comparison.success_condition: Correct finger deeply seated at the stop, display up, hand near its mark, device released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Although both benefit from bimanual stabilization, the oximeter tests compliant clipping onto a finger, not continuous support of an uncaged bearing block across a flush interface.
